scope: Index exact float32 source directions before procedural asteroid baking. Preserve expanded attribute bits and triangle order; no shader/instance/LOD/spin or real-model changes.

method.hardware: Native Chrome155, AMD Radeon Graphics / ANGLE D3D11,1280x720 DPR1, Yandex S3 assets, Vite dev server
method.frozen: Stop engine; reconstruct procedural baseline with independent original builder using the production profile/slot seed/detail/radius. Reconstruct real loaded models through the unchanged loader and impostor scaling path. Compare expanded attributes, then actual current geometry vs baseline on copied instance buffers and frozen uniforms/textures. Compare every HDR/depth component bit; require nonempty color/depth and same triangles. Views: front;2000km translation plus90-degree turn. Both Near and L0.
method.timing: Six warmup pairs then32 adjacent GPU-query pairs, alternating order; repeat whole batch. Drain after each pair. Isolated geometry draws, not whole-frame speedup.
method.motion: 64 real engine frames,4000km translation and360-degree turn; per-draw GPU queries inside RenderPass and CPU visibility timing with explicit frame-window guard. No paired baseline motion; volumes/postprocess excluded.

memory.note: Shared static position/normal/surfaceData/index bytes for the compared belt, excluding per-instance buffers and other cached radii/placeholders.

conclusions.buildWork: Detail0:60 surface evaluations instead of300, including four finite-difference normal samples per unique vertex; observed by passthrough spy, no CPU timing claim.
conclusions.remaining: Item16 remains open: visible geometry, volume dust and nebula reconstruction. Native single-device samples do not establish whole-frame or cross-device gains.
